Edit the supplied comments sheet to match the native 390x604 preview. Preserve every exact Japanese string, all colors, type sizes, icons, avatars, heart counts and horizontal positions. Keep all four hyperlink labels blue #1976D2 and keep 投稿者 green.

Correct only vertical row spacing. The current candidate’s second row is about 20px too low and third row about 35px too low relative to the preview. Keep the handle, title, and first comment row in place. Move the complete second row (avatar, author, badge, comment, heart/count, 返信する, divider and さらに18件の返信を見る) upward about 20px. Move the complete third row (avatar, author, timestamp, comment, heart/count and 返信する) upward about 35px. Match the native preview’s tighter row spacing.

Keep the reaction emoji row around y480 and the bottom composer around y531 in the 390x604 design. Do not move or resize the emoji row or composer. Preserve the exact three comments, all timestamps/counts, and the gray コメントを追加 placeholder. Do not add a send button or any content. Output the same 390x604 aspect ratio.
